ask_title: Ask Mochifile — describe what you need
ask_description: Describe what you want done to your images, video or PDFs in plain words. Ask Mochifile is a concept: it is not available yet.
ask_lead: Convert, resize, crop, remove backgrounds, turn PDF pages into images or pull the audio out of a video. Just describe it. No format pickers, no quality sliders.
ask_notice: Coming soon. Ask Mochifile can't process requests yet.
ask_trust_formats: JPG · PNG · WebP · AVIF · PDF · WebM
ask_examples_heading: Compression is just one thing you can ask for
ask_examples_lead: Type it the way you would say it. Mochifile is meant to work out the formats, sizes and settings. Tap any example to load it into the box.

ask_ex_video_1: Convert to WebM for the web
ask_ex_video_2: Keep only the audio as MP3
